title: Table — one Math Engine, top, legs and apron
description:
A parametric TABLE on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. In a space the table takes the space's LONGEST edge as its length direction, so a dining table in a rectangular room lands the way the room wants it without a rotation being typed.

THREE LEG STYLES, ONE TABLE. Four corner posts, a pair of trestle slabs joined by a stretcher, or a central pedestal on a foot — chosen by a ternary between three quad tables (`_isFour ? _FOUR : (_isTrestle ? _TRES : _PED)`), not by three flows. Each is a different number of rows in the same 11-column format, and everything downstream is unchanged.

THE APRON IS CONDITIONAL ON THE LEGS, not just on its checkbox: rails between the corner posts mean nothing on a pedestal, so `apron > 0 && _isFour` gates it and the false branch emits an EMPTY operand, which is the identity for `vcat`.

OVERHANG IS WHY THE TOP AND THE LEGS ARE MEASURED DIFFERENTLY. The top spans the full length and width; the legs sit on an inset rectangle, so raising the overhang pulls the legs in and leaves the top where it was — which is what an overhang is.

SEATS AROUND is a metric, not geometry: 0.60 m of edge per person on each of the four sides, floored — a sanity number for a dining layout that comes free from dimensions the flow already has.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped. Each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD: the legs sit INSIDE the top outline, and in one row they would void it into holes rather than reading as legs under a top.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 1.60 × 0.90 m at 0.75 m high on four 0.07 m posts, 1.44 m² of top, 6 seats around.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. The top is rectangular — a round or oval table is a different body, since a quad prism cannot express a circle. Legs are vertical and square; nothing is mitred or tapered.

params.name: Table maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Wd = width * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_topT = topThk * _s
_ov = overhang * _s
_lg = legSize * _s
_apD = apronDepth * _s
_apT = apronThk * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_v1 = _Wd / 2
_iu0 = _u0 + _ov
_iu1 = _u1 - _ov
_iv0 = _v0 + _ov
_iv1 = _v1 - _ov
_legTop = _Ht - _topT
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Wd
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Top
_TOP = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _legTop, _Ht, 1)
# Legs — four corner posts, two trestle slabs, or one central pedestal + foot
_isFour = legStyle == 'Four legs'
_isTrestle = legStyle == 'Trestle'
_F1 = hcat(_iu0, _iv0, _iu0 + _lg, _iv0, _iu0 + _lg, _iv0 + _lg, _iu0, _iv0 + _lg, 0, _legTop, 2)
_F2 = hcat(_iu1 - _lg, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0 + _lg, _iu1 - _lg, _iv0 + _lg, 0, _legTop, 2)
_F3 = hcat(_iu1 - _lg, _iv1 - _lg, _iu1, _iv1 - _lg, _iu1, _iv1, _iu1 - _lg, _iv1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_F4 = hcat(_iu0, _iv1 - _lg, _iu0 + _lg, _iv1 - _lg, _iu0 + _lg, _iv1, _iu0, _iv1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_FOUR = vcat(_F1, _F2, _F3, _F4)
_T1 = hcat(_iu0, _iv0, _iu0 + _lg, _iv0, _iu0 + _lg, _iv1, _iu0, _iv1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_T2 = hcat(_iu1 - _lg, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0, _iu1, _iv1, _iu1 - _lg, _iv1, 0, _legTop, 2)
_T3 = hcat(_iu0, 0 - _lg / 2, _iu1, 0 - _lg / 2, _iu1, _lg / 2, _iu0, _lg / 2, _legTop - 3 * _lg, _legTop - 2 * _lg, 2)
_TRES = vcat(_T1, _T2, _T3)
_pw = max(_lg, min(_Ln, _Wd) * 0.16)
_pf = max(_pw * 2, min(_Ln, _Wd) * 0.45)
_P1 = hcat(0 - _pw / 2, 0 - _pw / 2, _pw / 2, 0 - _pw / 2, _pw / 2, _pw / 2, 0 - _pw / 2, _pw / 2, 0.04 * _s, _legTop, 2)
_P2 = hcat(0 - _pf / 2, 0 - _pf / 2, _pf / 2, 0 - _pf / 2, _pf / 2, _pf / 2, 0 - _pf / 2, _pf / 2, 0, 0.04 * _s, 2)
_PED = vcat(_P1, _P2)
_LEGS = _isFour ? _FOUR : (_isTrestle ? _TRES : _PED)
# Apron — four rails just under the top, only where there are corner legs
_az1 = _legTop - 0.01 * _s
_az0 = _az1 - _apD
_R1 = hcat(_iu0, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0 + _apT, _iu0, _iv0 + _apT, _az0, _az1, 3)
_R2 = hcat(_iu0, _iv1 - _apT, _iu1, _iv1 - _apT, _iu1, _iv1, _iu0, _iv1, _az0, _az1, 3)
_R3 = hcat(_iu0, _iv0, _iu0 + _apT, _iv0, _iu0 + _apT, _iv1, _iu0, _iv1, _az0, _az1, 3)
_R4 = hcat(_iu1 - _apT, _iv0, _iu1, _iv0, _iu1, _iv1, _iu1 - _apT, _iv1, _az0, _az1, 3)
_APR = (apron > 0 && _isFour) ? vcat(_R1, _R2, _R3, _R4) : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_TOP, _LEGS, _APR)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Top3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Legs3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Apron3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
TopPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
LegsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ApronPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallLength = _Ln
overallWidth = _Wd
overallHeight = _Ht
topArea = _Ln * _Wd
kneeClear = _isFour ? (_az0 - (apron > 0 ? 0 : 0)) : _legTop
seatsAround = 2 * max(1, floor(_Ln / 0.6)) + 2 * max(0, floor(_Wd / 0.6))
footprint = _Ln * _Wd
